title_human: Finite classification theorem for the six canonical cubic sporadic zeta(3) Apery systems

claims.statement: L(G,5) = (144/25) zeta(5) is the exact critical value of the level-12 weight-6 source-first construction; the companion satisfies B = F D^{-5} G, with all-n integrality A_n in Z and d_n^5 B_n in Z, and a 253x253 finite-field certificate proves the companion does not belong to the complete natural 252-dimensional same-kernel fifth-order Frobenius-jet class.
claims.notes: Trunk context shared by both leaf chains (see trunk summary). The model states the fully normalized global W_12 Eichler/Fricke transformation A_n/B_n -> (144/25) zeta(5) is the 'main unfinished theorem' per the uploaded ledger, i.e. not yet proved at the time of this conversation. Included here only as background for chain-specific claims below; not re-derived in this branch's tail.

claims.statement: For twelve modular sporadic families A,B,C,D,E,F,alpha,gamma,delta,epsilon,zeta,eta, the canonical companion source Phi = F D_q t is exactly pure Eisenstein (cuspidal projection vanishes), certified through modularity, cusp-order calculations, Wronskian/ODE identities and Sturm bounds.
claims.notes: Trunk background claim, relevant because chain A's classification theorem builds on exactly this source-table machinery for the six cubic families {alpha,gamma,delta,epsilon,zeta,eta}.

claims.statement: Proposed object for classifying modular zeta(3) Apery systems: A = (X, t, L, F, Phi, nu), where X is a modular curve/quotient, t a MUM coordinate, L a rank-2 elliptic Gauss-Manin system, F in Sym^2(L) the normalized holomorphic period, and Phi = F D_t a weight-4 Eisenstein source whose Eichler primitive D^3 nu = Phi has target period in Q^x zeta(3); classification proceeds in three levels (homogeneous geometry mod algebraic correspondence/Kummer twist, then Eisenstein normal functions/extension classes over a fixed homogeneous class, then a category with arrows such as 'Euler seed -> CMF diagonal acceleration -> modular system').
claims.object: proposed finite classification framework for modular zeta(3) Apery systems
claims.notes: This is a proposed research programme/definition, not itself a proved theorem; it motivates the classification theorem proved later in the same message chain.

claims.statement: Domb, Apery, and the level-8 elliptic 'E' Catalan-related system meet on the modular curve X_0(6) as one homogeneous class, but occupy three distinct Eisenstein extension points (D, A, E) spanning a two-dimensional affine plane.
claims.notes: Cited as prior work justification for why the classification's 'homogeneous geometry' equivalence must be broader than rational pullback; presented as already established rather than newly proved in this message.

claims.statement: Theorem (canonical cubic sporadic zeta(3)-source classification). Exactly four of the six canonical cubic sporadic systems S_3 = {alpha,gamma,delta,epsilon,zeta,eta} are 'untwisted zeta(3)-type' (their sources Phi_f lie in the rational old-Eisenstein sector generated by E_4(d tau), i.e. L(Phi_f,s) = P_f(s) zeta(s) zeta(s-3) for a rational Dirichlet polynomial P_f): these are alpha, gamma, delta, epsilon; the other two, zeta and eta, are character-twisted (by chi_-3 and chi_5 respectively) and excluded from the untwisted census.
claims.object: six canonical cubic sporadic Apery systems S_3
claims.notes: Status 'proved' reflects the thread's own framing ('We now have a genuine first classification theorem'). Not independently verified here and not present in the ledger; see flags.

claims.statement: The exact source critical values are L(Phi_alpha,3) = (7/24) zeta(3), L(Phi_gamma,3) = (1/6) zeta(3), L(Phi_delta,3) = (13/54) zeta(3), L(Phi_epsilon,3) = (7/32) zeta(3), derived from coefficient vectors c_alpha=(1,-17,-9,16,153,0,-144,0), c_gamma=(1,-28,63,0,-36,0,0,0), c_delta=(1,-14,-1,16,14,0,-16,0), c_epsilon=(1,-21,0,84,0,-64,0,0) in the divisor basis d=(1,2,3,4,6,8,12,24).
claims.object: cubic sporadic zeta(3) source values for alpha, gamma, delta, epsilon
claims.notes: Presented as agreeing independently with the uploaded source-value table (sporadic_eisenstein_cooper_research_notes).

claims.statement: Among alpha, gamma, delta, epsilon, exactly alpha, gamma, epsilon are 'full Eisenstein period projectors' (P_f(0)=P_f(2)=P_f(4)=0); delta is the unique exception, with P_delta(2) = -4/3 and P_delta(4) = 5/27.
claims.object: period-projector purity of cubic sporadic zeta(3) sources
claims.notes: Framed as algebraically distinguishing delta as 'a different type of ζ(3) source', not merely numerically less attractive.

claims.statement: The homogeneous rank-3 Picard-Fuchs modules of alpha, gamma, delta, epsilon all belong to a single algebraic modular-correspondence class: via the second-order Zagier system correspondence (A,B,C,D,E,F) <-> (delta,zeta,alpha,eta,epsilon,gamma) and Zagier's identification of cases A, C, F with the same Beauville elliptic surface (family IV, modular group Gamma_1(6)), one gets delta ~_hom alpha ~_hom gamma; combined with a level-24 correspondence X_0(24) -> X_0(6)^+, X_0(24) -> X_0(8)^+ giving an algebraic rank-2 Kummer-twist equivalence between gamma and epsilon (gauge-isomorphic already over Q(X_0(24))), the full chain alpha ~_hom gamma ~_hom delta ~_hom epsilon holds, so all four collapse to one homogeneous class.
claims.object: homogeneous correspondence class of the four untwisted cubic zeta(3) systems
claims.notes: Uses external result: Zagier's classification of Beauville elliptic surfaces / family IV = Gamma_1(6) (connections_to_literature). Presented as an 'unexpected' single-class outcome by the thread.

claims.statement: Normalizing the four sources to a common zeta(3) target (lambda_alpha,lambda_gamma,lambda_delta,lambda_epsilon) = (24/7, 6, 54/13, 32/7), the pairwise-difference extension classes Delta_{alpha,gamma}, Delta_{alpha,delta}, Delta_{alpha,epsilon} are linearly independent (3x3 minor on divisors d=1,2,6 has determinant 128520 =/= 0), and by a 'prime-denominator injection lemma' (nonzero rational old-Eisenstein sources have nonzero Eichler extension class, via infinitely many primes p with v_p([q^{d0 p}]Theta_f) = -3) this independence survives to the extension classes; hence the four normalized normal functions Theta_alpha, Theta_gamma, Theta_delta, Theta_epsilon are affinely independent of dimension exactly 3, i.e. they form the four vertices of an affine 3-simplex (tetrahedron) over the single homogeneous elliptic class.
claims.object: extension-space dimension of the cubic zeta(3) classification
claims.notes: This is presented as one of the strongest outcomes of the census: 'one elliptic homogeneous class {alpha,gamma,delta,epsilon}_ext forms four vertices of an affine 3-simplex.'

claims.statement: Using the Atkin-Lehner involutions W_3, W_8 on level 24, the orbit rank of each pairwise difference source is: alpha-gamma: 4, alpha-delta: 4, alpha-epsilon: 3, gamma-delta: 4, gamma-epsilon: 4, delta-epsilon: 4; the single exceptional pair alpha-epsilon has W(Delta_{alpha,epsilon}) isomorphic to the augmentation representation of Q[(Z/2)^2], while every other pair carries the complete regular representation.
claims.object: Atkin-Lehner fingerprints of the cubic zeta(3) extension classes
claims.notes: Exact character (P(3)) fingerprint table also given for the three independent edges out of alpha.

claims.statement: Overall classification summary: 6 canonical cubic sporadic systems -> 4 untwisted zeta(3)-type -> 1 homogeneous elliptic class -> 4 extension vertices spanning an affine space of dimension 3; among those four, 3 (alpha, gamma, epsilon) are full period projectors and 1 (delta) is not. This is stated as a complete classification of the six systems with respect to Eisenstein character sector, zeta(3)-source period, critical-period projector purity, homogeneous modular-correspondence class, Eichler/Tate extension class, and Atkin-Lehner extension support -- explicitly not yet the full classification over all genus-zero congruence/Atkin-Lehner Apery systems, since a single Beauville elliptic surface can host multiple Picard-Fuchs equations depending on Hauptmodul placement.
claims.object: scope statement for the cubic sporadic zeta(3) classification theorem
claims.notes: The thread itself flags the limitation: this classifies only the six canonical sporadic rows, not the full universe of Beauville four-singular-fibre Hauptmodul placements. Proposed next step (enumerate all rational MUM Hauptmodul placements on the Beauville four-singular-fibre elliptic class) is an open thread, not completed.
